laws.rule: Walking around town in swimwear or undressed is fined; the fine range is €20 (about A$31.78 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026) to €1000 (about A$1,589 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026), and 16 fines of €20 had been issued (as reported by RTV Budva quoting municipal officials).
laws.heading: Swimwear in town

sources.title: U Budvi 30 kazni za hodanje gradom bez odjeće, u Tivtu 16

sources.supports: fines in Budva, Tivat, Ulcinj and Bar as reported by officials (read directly 2026-11-05)
